guides.favoredWhen: She Charms only when reflect is down and takes priority on your weak waveclear. Hold W, shove back.

keyTips.text: She never Charms into your reflect: Charm comes only once your W is down (about {cd:800:W}).
She ults in casting one spell per dash: reflect the last, not the first.
She throws Charm from behind a minion to force W first: hold W anyway.

tips.text: She dodges your missiles with W speed: lead the Qs.
Her fox-fires cannot be dodged and proc Electrocute: short W trades are hers, so respect.
She punishes your weak waveclear: her Q spam takes priority, so match it.
She answers instead of tanking minions: poke from range, never walk in.
She converts priority to map plays: pin her or lose the map.
She duels only at Charm-up angles: reflect down means no duel.

sources.author: Evandabank
sources.rankClaim: Grandmaster (title and profile badge) · Mel main

guides.favoredWhen: He kills once W is used and baits it with autos first. Hold W, punish WEQ.

keyTips.text: W used means you die: hold reflect for his all-in.
He calls ganks since you cannot escape: ward and track.
He pokes from 3 and backs off: reflect the second cast, not the first.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: In all-ins he autos first to bait W, then Q-E: never reflect the auto.
He steps back after WEQ: hold Q until he lands.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
E down means his aggressive all-ins: W is your life, so track yours.
Panic W loses: hold reflect until Qs fly.
